subject: Limitation of picture numbers in the shinyapps.io

messages.author: e9d9608a6a5832b4
messages.subject: Limitation of picture numbers in the shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi guys,

I made a very simple shiny app to show pictures according to the input. This app works well on my R studio. However, some of the pictures can't be seen after I put it to shinyapps.io

Can anyone give me a hint what may cause the problem? It there a limitation in the number or size of the picture or the folders?

Many thanks.

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Limitation of picture numbers in the shinyapps.io

messages.author: 3da48b33a2f506a9
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Limitation of picture numbers in the shinyapps.io
parts:
Hi Yixiang,

This is a case-sensitivity issue. Some of your image files have lowercase extension (.png). It happens that these are all the histograms images (e.g. QSPA-MD.png)
But your code references everything in uppercase (.PNG). 

Change the case and it should work.

Fereshteh
